name: Eric Zimmerman

positions.statement: On his campaign issues page, Zimmerman says opening more TASS shelter sites should be the city's highest priority because it is a shelter program that is working.
positions.excerpt: Opening more TASS sites should be the highest priority for the city because it’s a shelter program that is working.

positions.statement: On his campaign issues page, Zimmerman says public drug use is illegal and affects everyone.
positions.excerpt: Public drug use is illegal and it affects everyone.

positions.statement: On his campaign issues page, Zimmerman says Portland can be a hub of transportation options and accessibility innovations.
positions.excerpt: Portland can be a hub of transportation options and accessibility innovations.

positions.statement: On his campaign issues page, Zimmerman says neighborhood main streets should get city support as business and cultural hubs for neighborhoods.
positions.excerpt: They should get the city support they deserve as business and cultural hubs for our neighborhoods.

positions.statement: KPTV reported in February 2026 that Zimmerman and Mayor Keith Wilson seek to raise Portland's business tax exemption to $75,000 for tax year 2026 and $100,000 for 2027.
positions.excerpt: Zimmerman and Wilson seek to raise that exemption to $75,000 for the 2026 tax year, and to $100,000 for 2027.

positions.statement: In his 2025 year-in-review newsletter on his council page, Zimmerman's office says the city strongly believes immigrants are valued members of the community.
positions.excerpt: We strongly believe that immigrants are valued members of our community.

source.publisher: City of Portland, Councilor Zimmerman's office (portland.gov)

positions.statement: In his 2025 year-in-review newsletter, Zimmerman's office says Council passed the Sidewalk Improvement and Pavement Project (SIPP).
positions.excerpt: Council passed the Sidewalk Improvement and Pavement Project (SIPP).
